recommendation_summary: The reply rejects the APPROVED-column and initials proposal. For now, it says to keep the current folder for drafts only and add a separate release store. In that store, authors are read-only and only reviewers can write. Versions cannot be overwritten or deleted and are kept for 7 years. Each release records the file hash and version, an authenticated approver ID, a trusted timestamp and an audit log, and the approver must not be the author. It offers no optional additions and leaves no needs unmet. It does not say which tool would do this.
note: The recommendation covers every LARGER capability, but none of the four required labelled lines appear, so all four label checks fail.
